sections.text: A conditional planning estimate is available. It depends on the accepted assumptions and is not a guarantee of production performance. Treat this as a conditional planning view that depends on accepted assumptions. Use it to guide discussion, not as a performance promise.

The workload estimate is 8 GPUs. The selected factory deployment anchor is 256 GPUs. These are different quantities. HGX_B300: 8 estimated GPUs (sensitivity 8 to 8). HGX_B200: 8 estimated GPUs (sensitivity 8 to 8). HGX_H200: 8 estimated GPUs (sensitivity 8 to 8). Counts use whole GPU nodes. Spare compute does not establish an admitted tenant count. Sensitivity is not a confidence interval. The workload need and chosen factory size differ, and extra room does not mean customers are already assigned. Requirements still need architect review.

Required memory per GPU: 58.359738 GB. Selected hardware memory per GPU: 288 GB. Host RAM provision for the workload: 2048 GB. Host local disk provision: 30720 GB. Host provisions are planning assumptions. Per-device memory fit matters, not just aggregate memory. Working memory per device matters more than a pooled total. The host memory and local disk figures are planning assumptions, not measured usage.

No local shared-storage capacity has been established. This is not a zero-storage requirement. An outside corpus is not automatically copied into this factory. The absence of a local shared store is an unresolved requirement, not an empty need. Outside files are not copied in unless the architect plans that step.

External customer datacenter ingress: unresolved. North-south ingress: unresolved. Dedicated storage read/write links: unresolved / unresolved. East-west link per GPU: unresolved. Storage networking is physically dedicated, not converged. External and north-south rates describe the same traffic at different boundaries and must not be added together. These are lower bounds, not selected circuit sizes. Traffic entering the factory and communication between GPUs still need measurement before link choices. Treat missing rates as open questions, not as no traffic.

Review assumptions and outstanding measurements with the architect. Prepare or use the saved design handoff together with its companion requirements. Provide the initial customer-datacenter data volume and allowed transfer window. Ongoing bulk transfers are unspecified. Daily-volume rates are averages over 24 hours, not measured burst rates. Measure aggregate storage read and write throughput. Storage capacity alone does not determine fabric bandwidth. East-west per-GPU port demand needs the selected reference design and collective-communication measurements. Customer-datacenter round-trip latency objective is unspecified. A saved projection exists. Fields marked brief_only must be applied separately by the architect. Review the saved handoff with the architect and collect the missing traffic and storage measurements. Unresolved items remain open until the architect records decisions.
